ready.description: the matrix or diagnosis is ready and the programmer can start

split.description: if the task must be split (rules: "Split the task") - the proposed subtasks

mechanismSection.description: only the analyst before the first programmer (analystFirst): true when you wrote a section "Mechanism" into analyst.md in this answer

mechanismOrCells.description: only when the prompt asks "mechanism or cells?" (a second red or a second rejection): mechanism - the reds show the mechanism is wrong and analyst.md replaces it (a new section "Mechanism"); cells - new cells of the same mechanism
